_comment: Registry of C's recommendation cards. The hub (index.html) renders this list; the recommendation agent appends one entry per delivery and never repeats a slug.

recs.title: Wayward Lives, Beautiful Experiments
recs.author: Saidiya Hartman
recs.teaser: Philadelphia and New York, 1890–1935: young Black women whose only surviving records were written by the people who policed them. The book where your feminism wall and your E. H. Carr shelf have to argue it out.

recs.title: Kairos
recs.author: Jenny Erpenbeck
recs.teaser: A love affair in the last years of East Berlin — the novel your German shelf, your Ernaux and your history-of-memory books have been circling for years. International Booker Prize 2024.

recs.title: Invisible Women
recs.author: Caroline Criado Perez
recs.teaser: The data book your feminism wall is missing: how a world built on male-default data quietly fails half the population — from crash-test dummies to drug trials.

recs.title: The Dawn of Everything
recs.author: David Graeber & David Wengrow
recs.teaser: The book that argues with your Sapiens — a historian-grade retelling of humanity's deep past that your E. H. Carr and Koselleck shelf will want to referee.
